control_flow: avoidWalls: if RLIGHT is below 60 %, then if the front sensor sees an obstacle turn left 15°, else if the left sensor sees one turn right 15°, else call driveInTheDark; otherwise call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 %, drive forward at 30 %, else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if the front sensor sees an obstacle, stop, else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left, else curve right.

uncertainties: The program reads the left obstacle sensor but not the right: a wall close on the right is only noticed once it is straight ahead, so the robot may bump in a left bend.
In the dark, the front sensor also starts a 15° left turn, even for a wall straight ahead, which you didn't describe.
In bright light it follows a line and stops at a wall; on a plain floor it circles to the right.
Whether a right-hand wall is ever seen by the front sensor in a left bend depends on how the robot drifts, so that path is uncertain.
